content.comment_body: Hello experts, does anyone know how to create a web page for [product_name] [article_no], allowing control of certain variables through an IP address? Any help or examples would be appreciated.

Hi, I don't think [company_name] openly provides this data. I tried using network monitoring tools like Wireshark, but couldn't find much. I believe there should be a simple command, but haven't found it yet. For example, using SNMP commands like: snmpset -v1 -c private 10.0.1.30 .1.3.6.1.4.1.19865.1.2.1.1.0 i 1, I can set input and output states on my LAN-based relay. The setup for [product_name] appears similar, but I haven't had success so far. I will try again. [user_name]
Thank you for your efforts. Could you please provide a bit more detail? I understand some parts. [user_name]
